question: A, B, and C can complete a work in 15, 30, and 20 days respectively. A left the work 1 day before the work was completed and B left 2 days before the completion of the work. Find the number of days required to complete the whole work.
solution:
**Given data:**

A can complete the work in 15 days

B can complete the work in 30 days

C can complete the work in 20 days

**Concept: **Use the concept of work and time and LCM.

**Solution:**

LCM of 15, 30, 20 = 60 units (Assume total work)

Efficiency of A = Total work / A&
